title: Employ only accredited teachers
what: Employ a person to teach in a school or early childhood education centre only if the person is accredited.

sources.title: Teacher Accreditation Act 2004 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not employ another person to teach in a school or early childhood education centre unless the other person— (a) is accredited,
